[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A whole capture item `=<X>#<pomodoro>` (for example `=#deep-work`, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`=3#bugs`, `=-2#bugs`) starts the named Pomodoro now with `se<X>` [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]matches (whole slug, else prefix), or a new session named like a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]completed match, or a brand-new named session. The token composes [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]in same-line chains (`=x =#bugs` switches sessions in one line). [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`bob capture-parse` and `bob capture-complete` expose it, and Bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Mac Capture completes the name with a start-aware list, highlights [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]it, previews the session live, and teaches the syntax.[/#D7D7AF]
